description: This file defines the ConduitContext class, an Entity Framework Core DbContext implementation for the Conduit application. It configures entity relationships, primary keys, foreign keys, and transaction management for the application's data access layer.

classes.name: ConduitContext
classes.description: EF Core DbContext for the Conduit application, handling data sets for articles, comments, people, tags, and relationships including transaction management.

methods.name: OnModelCreating
methods.description: Configures entity relationships, primary keys, and delete behaviors for the database schema.

methods.name: BeginTransaction
methods.description: Starts a new database transaction if none is active.

methods.name: CommitTransaction
methods.description: Commits the current transaction; rolls back if an error occurs.

methods.name: RollbackTransaction
methods.description: Rolls back the current transaction without error.
